name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted data logger for Tesla vehicles that records drives, charging and battery health in PostgreSQL, with bundled Grafana dashboards.

alerts.message: TeslaMate has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with TESLAMATE_USERNAME and TESLAMATE_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Grafana under /grafana uses GRAFANA_ADMIN_USER and GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD, applied on the first start only.

TeslaMate cannot create Tesla tokens itself: paste an access and refresh token generated by a separate token app. Then set Settings > URLs in TeslaMate to https://<domain> and https://<domain>/grafana.
